markets.description: This market will settle to the winner of Set 4 in the Volkov Yurii vs Kovshun Yaroslav Setka Cup Ukraine Men match scheduled for November 3, 2026 at 12:30AM ET (as of the listing of the event's first instrument). If the match does not begin due to a walkover, withdrawal, or cancellation, the market will settle to $0.50. If a player retires during the match and the market can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed, the market will settle accordingly; otherwise the market will settle to $0.50. If the match is delayed, postponed, suspended or otherwise rescheduled to a date and time not within two days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to $0.50.
